name: page_id
description: Page snapshot key: frame_id + page index

name: page_type
description: home = frame URL; task = public task page linked from the homepage

name: task_category
description: Task type of the page (null for home). Hand-screened on a stratified sample by ML (Oct 10, 2026): keyword accuracy 71% (37/52, Wilson 95% CI 58-82%) before correction; 14 rows corrected; not gold-standard

name: task_category_source
description: ml_screen = label set/corrected by ML hand screen; keyword = keyword heuristic only (unscreened or screened-correct, sample IDs not recorded)

name: org_group
description: Cross-country brand/parent group (e.g. BAC, Tigo (Millicom)); else = org_name. CV grouping key

name: final_url
description: URL after redirects, query string and fragment stripped; null on offsite redirect

name: registrable_domain
description: Registrable domain of url (grouping key for CV)

name: audit_status
description: Outcome of the audit; failed/bot_challenge/skipped_* => all metric fields null (enforced by schema)

name: failure_reason
description: Reason for skip/failure/partial (e.g. offsite_redirect:<registrable_domain>, navigation_error:chrome_error_page, bot_challenge:<marker>, robots_disallow)

name: http_status
description: HTTP status of main document in the axe load

name: content_sha256
description: SHA-256 hex of visible text (text discarded)

name: axe_nodes_total
description: Failing elements across all violated rules

name: axe_incomplete_rules
description: Rules axe could not decide (need manual review)

name: lh_perf_score
description: Performance category score, mobile, simulated slow 4G

name: read_word_count
description: Words in visible text; task pages only (null for page_type=home)

name: read_sentence_count
description: Sentences in visible text; task pages only (null for page_type=home)

name: read_fernandez_huerta
description: Fernández-Huerta readability (higher = easier); null if read_flag != ok; task pages only

name: read_szigriszt_pazos
description: Szigriszt-Pazos perspicuity / INFLESZ (higher = easier); null if read_flag != ok; task pages only

name: read_flag
description: Readability sanity gate: ok; wps_gt_80 (words/sentence > 80, segmentation failed, e.g. lists/menus) or score_out_of_range (outside 0-100) => scores null, counts kept; null for home/no text

name: sc_id
description: WCAG SC dotted id; joins ml/wcag_older_adult_map.csv sc_id

name: task_category
description: Task type of the page (null for home). Hand-screened on a stratified sample by ML (Oct 10, 2026): keyword accuracy 71% (37/52, Wilson 95% CI 58-82%) before correction; 14 rows corrected; not gold-standard

name: task_category_source
description: ml_screen = label set/corrected by ML hand screen; keyword = keyword heuristic only (unscreened or screened-correct, sample IDs not recorded)

name: found_via
description: How the URL was found (homepage link + keyword)

name: http_status
description: HTTP status at check time (HEAD, GET fallback)

name: robots_allowed
description: robots.txt allows this path for UA AccesoMayor-LatAm
